Courses on Khan Academy are always 100% free. Start practicing—and saving your progress—now! https://www.khanacademy.org/science/ms-biology/x0c5bb03129646fd6:matter-and-energy-in-ecosystems/x0c5bb03129646fd6:photosynthesis-in-ecosystems/v/trophic-levels

Explore how energy flows and matter cycles through a kelp forest ecosystem. Food chains and trophic levels trace energy from kelp to sea urchins, sea otters, and orcas. The 10% rule and energy pyramids show why less energy is available at higher trophic levels. Decomposers recycle nutrients, helping sustain producers and the entire ecosystem.
